scope: Environment dataset coverage of the Mendwell delivery dataset mendwell-delivery-2025-2026, whole window. Not a Task history report: a Task reports its own selection after its first-session cutoff (dataset/as-of.cjs).
counting: Every timestamp is ISO 8601 with its offset; each is converted to its calendar date in America/New_York before counting. Date-only fields (a prescription's written_on, a claim's eligible_on) are not occurrence dates and are not counted. A date counts once however many records or sources fall on it. A required occurrence date (received_at, requested_at, created_at or at) that is missing or not a valid ISO 8601 instant with the offset in force, and a record outside the window, is excluded from the count and listed by ID; closed_at and revoked_at are required only of closed fills and revoked grants. There are none.

sources.role: Seed at the window start 2025-01-01T00:00:00-05:00: the household, prescribers, drugs with their 24 facts paraphrased from the cited DailyMed labels, plans, cash prices, stores (stock before the restocks) and cards; no records.
Every committed step in time order: the household members' tool calls and Infra events, each with its time.
Seed at 2027-01-01T00:00:00-05:00, the state after every step with the timers due before that instant committed: all records of the window, with the same catalog and label facts.

exclusions.reason: Household and catalog rows with no occurrence date; their dated changes are replay steps (store.restocked) and records (grants). Store stock is the only catalog field that changes in the window.
Price table per drug, no occurrence date.
Holds only the household and catalog at the window start; no dated records.
A confirmation (user.confirmed) is applied with the prepayment or grant change it confirms and is not kept, because seeds carry no approvals; the confirmed step itself is in dataset/replay.json.

distinct_dates.coverage_basis: Counted over the records loaded into the App (dataset/full.json), which Agents and Infra read back.
distinct_dates.coverage_note: The global count over both sources adds 2 days on which the replay log holds steps but no App record is dated.

provenance.note: Every dated record and step is synthetic, written by the App while dataset/generate.cjs replayed it; none was collected or observed, including those dated at or after the reference clock.

label_facts.rule: The drug facts are short paraphrases of public DailyMed labels, read on 2026-11-23 and cited by section in contribution/dataset.json. They sit in the drug catalog, carry no occurrence date and are not counted as dated records. A label's facts count as real data in use only when the dataset holds a prescription of that drug, because rx.get returns them with that prescription (shown by the loading demonstration); the table lists the prescriptions and fills per label.

partitions.partition: synthetic, dated before the reference clock
synthetic, dated at or after the reference clock: generated, never observed

household.supply_method: A documented lost supply (a plan request noted "Replacement for a lost supply") empties all supply on hand at the moment the household asks for the replacement, the lost-supply fill's requested_at; supply restarts with the next pickup. Every other pickup adds its days of supply to whatever is left (supply carries over).

gaps.reason: There is no real pharmacy record to collect: prescriptions, fills, claims and payments are a real patient's protected health information, the reference product shows them only inside a signed-in account, and the approved proposal (PR #63, https://github.com/MatrAIx-ai/Personal-Agents-Last-Exam/blob/c7ddf519b029cebe1c93c5bed50edb889cf34deb/proposals/environment/mendwell-pharmacy.md at the approved revision) excludes real patient data (line 12) and data collection (line 102: "N/A: no crawling or copied content; record public workflow references"). The only real source data are the DailyMed label facts read on 2026-11-23, which are reference content in the catalog, not pharmacy activity; every dated record of the window is synthetic.
The 472 notices are in the App's own notice log only; the dataset holds no Mail history for them. Mail is optional, and the Mail sender treats notices present in a loaded seed as history.
